requirements.invariant: One manual refresh presents a complete PendingLocalWorkSummary validated against constructor-bound expected environment, Principal and Account, preserving queued-operation, applying-operation, unresolved-rejection and unverified-attachment counts as four independent UInt64 values. The query port remains argument-free.

Only a successfully validated all-zero summary may display no pending local work. Every nonzero class remains separately visible, and loading, failure, cancellation, malformed or rebound evidence never appears clean or becomes an inferred zero.

The Core-only AppModel owns not-requested, loading, clean, pending and failed presentation plus manual refresh lifecycle. A fresh UUID generation token prevents replaced, cancelled, stopped or noncooperative late work from mutating current state without relying on a wrapping counter.

A MainActor-serialized admitted-task registry registers before launch or possible completion, retains cancelled or replaced work until joined, atomically makes stop terminal for that AppModel instance, refuses late admission, cancels and drains the whole retired-plus-current set, then permits Account runtime close. Each newly opened staging runtime receives a fresh child instance; runtime close cannot race any admitted application read.

A narrow AppModel port returns only PendingLocalWorkSummary. The AppModel binds expected environment, Principal and Account at construction; the target-app adapter forwards LedgerOfflineClientRuntime.pendingWorkSummary without scope arguments or alternate semantics. No PowerSync, database, SQL, credential, key, provider or generic backend type crosses into AppModel.

The surface reports local evidence only. It never claims synced, uploaded, remotely durable or safe to log out and exposes no session disposition, sync, upload, destructive Account/session cleanup, database/key/media deletion, signout, Account switching, retention or authorization-lease action. Ordinary model stop/drain and runtime resource teardown remain required.

Executable work is limited to four owned leaves and frozen target-staging composition, generated project, environment checker and conversion-control touchpoints. It adds no schema, RLS, Data API, Sync Stream, provider, Storage, MCP, Auth, hosted resource, Firebase, source data, migration, release, production or cutover behavior.

items: Manual refresh reads the existing encrypted Account-local summary without a network round trip and preserves exact scope, four counts, revision, observed time and fingerprint in typed model state.

A MainActor-serialized admitted-task registry registers work before launch, retains replaced or cancelled tasks until joined, and generation isolation discards noncooperative late results; cancellation remains control flow and failure never preserves a false clean state.

Stop atomically becomes terminal for one child instance, refuses late admission, clears presented evidence and runtime closure, cancels and drains the whole retired-plus-current task set, and must finish before Account runtime close in both normal and failed staging resource teardown. A reopened runtime receives a fresh child.

verification.expected: All-zero, each individual pending class, mixed counts and UInt64.max preserve four exact values; only validated all-zero presents no pending local work and no label claims remote success or logout safety.

Exact environment/Principal/Account, revision, observedAt and fingerprint survive projection; same counts with changed revision/time/fingerprint remain distinct evidence, and each foreign environment, Principal and Account dimension fails closed.
The AppModel port has no scope parameter and the thin adapter forwards exactly one runtime pendingWorkSummary call without rebinding or exposing provider types.
Thrown bounded/unknown failures, malformed or rebound summaries and spontaneous upstream cancellation present failure with no counts and never preserve a prior clean/pending result as current truth.

Overlapping refresh registers replacement before launch, cancels and retains the prior request until joined; a deliberately noncooperative retired result cannot overwrite the current generation, while the replacement result can after prior drainage.

With overlapping retired and current noncooperative refresh work, stop atomically becomes terminal, refuses late refresh, cancels and joins the entire registry before returning, is repeatable, and leaves no task able to mutate terminal state.
